breakdown.description: The workflow explicitly includes an NSCF step before DOS post-processing, but the prompt later instructs skipping that NSCF step.
breakdown.reason: The ground truth resolves the contradiction by removing the instruction to skip the NSCF step, preserving the full 6-step workflow (vc-relax → scf → nscf → bands → band post-processing → DOS post-processing). However, the generated specification explicitly states 'Skip the separate NSCF step; feed the scf charge density directly to the DOS calculation,' which repeats the erroneous instruction from the incomplete prompt rather than aligning with the ground truth's complete workflow.
